subject: HIGH: RP8 vs RP9 share 73% of answers — Kai can memorize pattern
body:
GP consecutive exam comparison (gp-exam-compare-consecutive.js) found critical memorization risk:

RP8 vs RP9: 16/22 answers shared (73%) — ABOVE CRITICAL THRESHOLD

Shared values: -1, 6, -4, 1, 5, -6, 10, 1.5, and more.

If Kai studies RP8 then takes RP9, 73% of the answers appear in both exams. This undermines the purpose of having separate retake exams.

Other high overlaps:
- RP2 vs RP3: 59% shared
- RP6 vs RP7: 58% shared
- RP7 vs RP8: 56% shared

GR action needed:
1. Vary numeric answer values in RP9 so fewer match RP8
2. Review RP2/RP3 and RP6/RP7 pairs for similar diversification
3. Target: less than 40% answer overlap between any two consecutive exams

Report: node scripts/gp-exam-compare-consecutive.js
